order_arms.ORIGINAL: source canonical row order; no mapping member
order_arms.CANONICAL_SPATIAL: stable lexicographic sort by finite coordinate tuple, then original spot identity, then original row index

order_mapping: uint32 little-endian encoded-row-to-original-row permutation stored as order_map.u32 and charged in mapping bytes

context_arms.S0V0: support M=0, unconditional value model, no graph member
context_arms.S1V0: support M=6, unconditional value model, one shared production graph member
context_arms.S0V1: existing SPATIAL_M00 support archive, production value context and graph; semantic-audit reuse
context_arms.S1V1: existing SPATIAL_M06 support archive, production value context and graph; semantic-audit reuse

bucket_selection: pooled total physical bytes; <=0.05 percent tie then smaller B; no per-sample B selection
failure_rule: retain every attempt; retry only native/Numba startup signature once; integrity, exactness and resource failures stop that arm
decoder_contract: archive-only fresh process; no H5AD or raw-source path access; canonical CSR exactness plus ordered metadata and mapping inversion
historical_evidence_policy: COUNT-SUPPORT-PREDECESSOR-50-001 and value K32 archives are immutable inputs; no overwrite
